messages.content: What change was proposed for HTTPX 301/302 redirects, and what concern did maintainers raise about adding the option? Is the decision accepted or unresolved?

The proposed change was to add an option to HTTPX clients to keep the same HTTP method for 301/302 redirects instead of switching to GET, as the RFC is not clear on the expected behavior and some server applications expect the legacy behavior [e57b53bf-a0bb-4f73-af89-4a8ea94360f1]. A maintainer raised the concern that they would rather not have configuration options to support esoteric configurations, suggesting that redirects should be disabled and handled directly for such use cases [a0e5649a-3470-4ca8-90bb-0025a5e90d79]. The decision is currently unresolved, with a review status of needs_review [e57b53bf-a0bb-4f73-af89-4a8ea94360f1].
